name: Mercado Libre
description: LATAM's largest marketplace: search items, read products and sellers, list orders, and manage the seller's own listings (create, validate, change price, stock and description, pause or close) on Brasil (MLB), Argentina (MLA), Mexico (MLM), Chile (MLC), Colombia (MCO), Peru (MPE) and Uruguay (MLU). Sign in with the seller's Mercado Libre account.
instructions:
This connector uses the Mercado Libre REST API (api.mercadolibre.com), one API for every country site. Every endpoint needs the seller's OAuth2 sign-in; unauthenticated calls get 401 or 403.

**Setup**: in the developer center of your country (https://developers.mercadolibre.com/devcenter) create an application, register the redirect URI `<your AnythingMCP URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` (on AnythingMCP Cloud: `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback`) and copy the App ID and the Secret Key into `MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID` and `MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET`. `MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN` picks the sign-in page of the seller's country (mercadolivre.com.br, mercadolibre.com.ar, mercadolibre.com.mx, mercadolibre.cl, mercadolibre.com.co, mercadolibre.com.pe, mercadolibre.com.uy). Then authorize the connector with the seller account. Keep the scopes `offline_access read write`: the listing tools need write.

**Site ids**: MLB = Brasil, MLA = Argentina, MLM = Mexico, MLC = Chile, MCO = Colombia, MPE = Peru, MLU = Uruguay. Item ids carry the site prefix (`MLB1234567890`), and so do category ids (`MLB1055`).

**Your seller id**: `mercado_libre_get_user` with user_id `me` returns the signed-in account; its `id` is the seller id for `mercado_libre_list_seller_items` and `mercado_libre_list_orders`. Seller endpoints only answer for the signed-in seller.

**Creating a listing** (there is no sandbox, so whatever is created is live):
1. `mercado_libre_predict_category` with the product title gives the category_id.
2. `mercado_libre_get_category_attributes` lists the attributes; send every one tagged required (often BRAND, MODEL, GTIN). `mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms` gives the warranty fields and `mercado_libre_list_listing_types` the listing types (gold_special = classic, gold_pro = premium). `mercado_libre_get_category` has the limits: max_title_length, max_pictures_per_item, minimum_price.
3. `mercado_libre_validate_listing` with the full listing; an empty answer means it would be accepted.
4. `mercado_libre_create_listing`, then `mercado_libre_add_listing_description` with the text.

**Title or family_name**: sellers on the User Products model (most sellers since 2025) send `family_name`, a generic product name such as 'Apple iPhone 15 128GB', and no `title`: Mercado Libre writes the title itself. Sellers still on the old model send `title`. The error 'The fields [title] are invalid' means: send family_name instead. A listing that has a family_name does not accept title changes.

**Changing listings**: `mercado_libre_update_listing` changes price, stock, pictures, attributes and sale terms (send only what changes; pictures and attributes replace the whole list). Stock 0 pauses the listing until stock comes back. `mercado_libre_set_listing_status` pauses or reactivates, `mercado_libre_update_listing_description` replaces the text. Title, condition and buying mode are locked once a listing has sales. `mercado_libre_close_listing` ends a listing for good and is installed switched off. Every write acts on the live shop: confirm each one with the user.

**Rate limits**: Mercado Libre answers 429 when an application sends too many requests. Wait before retrying and do not fire many listing changes in parallel.
prerequisites: An application in the Mercado Libre developer center of **your country**, with the redirect URI shown below registered exactly.

MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID.label: App ID
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID.help: Developer center → your application: the App ID (Client ID).
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: The App ID is a number of about 16 digits, shown at the top of your application in the developer center.

MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Secret key
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same page: the Secret Key (Client Secret).
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: The Secret Key is a string of about 32 letters and digits, on the same page as the App ID. It is not your Mercado Libre password.

MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN.label: Country site
MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN.help: The Mercado Libre site your account is on: mercadolivre.com.br (Brazil), mercadolibre.com.ar, mercadolibre.com.mx, mercadolibre.cl, mercadolibre.com.co, mercadolibre.com.uy, mercadolibre.com.pe.
MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN.patternMessage: One of the country sites listed, e.g. mercadolibre.com.mx.

tools.name: mercado_libre_search_items
tools.description: Search items in a Mercado Libre site (country marketplace). Returns matches with item id (e.g. 'MLB1234567890'), title, price, currency, condition (new/used), thumbnail, seller id, available_quantity, and permalink to the listing.

site_id.description: Site code: MLB=Brasil, MLA=Argentina, MLM=Mexico, MLC=Chile, MCO=Colombia, MPE=Peru, MLU=Uruguay.

category.description: Optional Mercado Libre category id to scope the search (e.g. 'MLB1144' for video games on the Brasil site).

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_item
tools.description: Fetch full details for a Mercado Libre item by id. Returns title, description, price, currency, listing type, all attributes (brand, model, condition, …), pictures, available_quantity, sold_quantity, warranty, seller_id, and shipping options.

item_id.description: Mercado Libre item id including site prefix (e.g. 'MLB1234567890').

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_user
tools.description: Get a user's public profile (typically used to inspect a seller). Returns id, nickname, country_id, registration_date, seller_reputation (level_id, transactions completed/canceled, ratings positive/neutral/negative), and listing site.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_orders
tools.description: List orders for an authenticated seller. Requires an OAuth2 token belonging to the seller. Returns order id, status (paid/cancelled/confirmed), date_created, total amount, buyer summary, order items, and shipping details.

seller.description: Seller id (must match the authenticated user's id).

tools.name: mercado_libre_predict_category
tools.description: Suggest the category for a new listing from its title (the category predictor). Returns up to 8 predictions, most likely first, each with category_id, category_name, domain_id and the attributes it read from the title (e.g. BRAND, MODEL). Start here before creating a listing.

site_id.description: Site code: MLB=Brasil, MLA=Argentina, MLM=Mexico, MLC=Chile, MCO=Colombia, MPE=Peru, MLU=Uruguay.

q.description: Product title in the site's language, e.g. 'celular iphone 15 128gb'.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_category
tools.description: Read a category and the rules a listing in it must follow: path_from_root, listing_allowed, status, and settings such as max_title_length, buying_modes, currencies, item_conditions, max_pictures_per_item, minimum_price and shipping_modes.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_category_attributes
tools.description: List the attributes (technical specifications) of a category: id, name, value_type, allowed values with their value_id, and tags. Attributes tagged required must be sent to create a listing, new_required ones when the condition is new; read_only ones cannot be set.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms
tools.description: List the sale terms of a category, such as WARRANTY_TYPE and WARRANTY_TIME with their allowed values and units, to fill sale_terms when creating or changing a listing.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_listing_types
tools.description: List the listing types of a site (e.g. gold_pro, gold_special, free) with their names. A listing needs a listing_type_id; exposure and selling fees depend on it.

site_id.description: Site code: MLB=Brasil, MLA=Argentina, MLM=Mexico, MLC=Chile, MCO=Colombia, MPE=Peru, MLU=Uruguay.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_seller_items
tools.description: List the ids of a seller's listings, 50 per page by default (max 100), optionally filtered by status or SKU. Use mercado_libre_get_user with user_id 'me' to find your own seller id, and mercado_libre_get_item for the details of each id. offset stops at 1000.

user_id.description: Seller id (numeric). Must be the account the connector is signed in with.

seller_sku.description: Only listings whose SELLER_SKU attribute has this value.

tools.name: mercado_libre_validate_listing
tools.description: Check a new listing without publishing it. Takes the same fields as mercado_libre_create_listing; an empty answer (HTTP 204) means it would be accepted, otherwise the answer lists every problem (missing attributes, wrong fields, title not allowed). Run this before creating.

family_name.description: Generic product name shared by its variants, e.g. 'Apple iPhone 15 128GB'. Required for sellers on the User Products model (most sellers now); Mercado Libre then writes the title itself. At most the category's max_title_length.

title.description: Listing title, only for sellers still on the old model (Product + brand + model + key specs, no condition, stock or shipping words). If Mercado Libre answers 'The fields [title] are invalid', send family_name instead.

price.description: Price in the site currency, e.g. 199.9.

currency_id.description: Currency of the site: BRL, ARS, MXN, CLP, COP, PEN or UYU.

available_quantity.description: Units in stock (0 creates the listing paused, out of stock).

listing_type_id.description: Listing type, e.g. gold_special (classic) or gold_pro (premium); see mercado_libre_list_listing_types.

pictures.description: Pictures as [{"source": "https://...jpg"}]: public image URLs, the first one is the cover. The category sets the maximum (max_pictures_per_item).

attributes.description: Technical specifications as [{"id": "BRAND", "value_name": "Apple"}] or with "value_id" for list values. Send every attribute tagged required in mercado_libre_get_category_attributes (often BRAND, MODEL and GTIN); a SKU goes in SELLER_SKU.

sale_terms.description: Sale terms such as the warranty: [{"id": "WARRANTY_TYPE", "value_name": "Garantia do vendedor"}, {"id": "WARRANTY_TIME", "value_name": "90 dias"}]. Allowed values: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms.

value_name.description: Value as text, with its unit where it has one.

shipping.description: Optional shipping settings, e.g. {"mode": "me2", "free_shipping": false, "local_pick_up": false}. Leave out to use the seller's defaults.

tools.name: mercado_libre_create_listing
tools.description: Publish a new listing on the seller's account; it goes live and can sell at once. Send family_name (User Products sellers) or title, never both. Get category_id from mercado_libre_predict_category and the required attributes from mercado_libre_get_category_attributes, run mercado_libre_validate_listing first, then add the text with mercado_libre_add_listing_description. Show the user the listing and wait for confirmation; never retry a successful create.

family_name.description: Generic product name shared by its variants, e.g. 'Apple iPhone 15 128GB'. Required for sellers on the User Products model (most sellers now); Mercado Libre then writes the title itself. At most the category's max_title_length.

title.description: Listing title, only for sellers still on the old model (Product + brand + model + key specs, no condition, stock or shipping words). If Mercado Libre answers 'The fields [title] are invalid', send family_name instead.

price.description: Price in the site currency, e.g. 199.9.

currency_id.description: Currency of the site: BRL, ARS, MXN, CLP, COP, PEN or UYU.

available_quantity.description: Units in stock (0 creates the listing paused, out of stock).

listing_type_id.description: Listing type, e.g. gold_special (classic) or gold_pro (premium); see mercado_libre_list_listing_types.

pictures.description: Pictures as [{"source": "https://...jpg"}]: public image URLs, the first one is the cover. The category sets the maximum (max_pictures_per_item).

attributes.description: Technical specifications as [{"id": "BRAND", "value_name": "Apple"}] or with "value_id" for list values. Send every attribute tagged required in mercado_libre_get_category_attributes (often BRAND, MODEL and GTIN); a SKU goes in SELLER_SKU.

sale_terms.description: Sale terms such as the warranty: [{"id": "WARRANTY_TYPE", "value_name": "Garantia do vendedor"}, {"id": "WARRANTY_TIME", "value_name": "90 dias"}]. Allowed values: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms.

value_name.description: Value as text, with its unit where it has one.

shipping.description: Optional shipping settings, e.g. {"mode": "me2", "free_shipping": false, "local_pick_up": false}. Leave out to use the seller's defaults.

tools.name: mercado_libre_update_listing
tools.description: Change a listing: price, stock (available_quantity), pictures, attributes, sale terms, video or shipping. Send only the fields to change; pictures and attributes replace the whole list. title only while nothing has sold and only on old-model listings (with family_name set, change family_name instead). Stock 0 pauses the listing. Confirm with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

price.description: New price in the listing currency.

available_quantity.description: New stock. 0 pauses the listing as out of stock; a positive number reactivates it.

title.description: New title. Only allowed while sold_quantity is 0 and the listing has no family_name.

family_name.description: New generic product name (User Products listings), only while no item of the product has sold.

pictures.description: Pictures as [{"source": "https://...jpg"}]: public image URLs, the first one is the cover. The category sets the maximum (max_pictures_per_item).

attributes.description: Technical specifications as [{"id": "BRAND", "value_name": "Apple"}] or with "value_id" for list values. Send every attribute tagged required in mercado_libre_get_category_attributes (often BRAND, MODEL and GTIN); a SKU goes in SELLER_SKU.

sale_terms.description: Sale terms such as the warranty: [{"id": "WARRANTY_TYPE", "value_name": "Garantia do vendedor"}, {"id": "WARRANTY_TIME", "value_name": "90 dias"}]. Allowed values: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms.

value_name.description: Value as text, with its unit where it has one.

tools.name: mercado_libre_set_listing_status
tools.description: Pause a listing (hidden from buyers, can be reactivated) or reactivate a paused one. A listing paused for lack of stock comes back by itself when mercado_libre_update_listing sets stock above 0. To end a listing for good use mercado_libre_close_listing. Confirm with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

status.description: paused hides the listing, active reactivates it.

tools.name: mercado_libre_close_listing
tools.description: End a listing for good (status closed). A closed listing cannot be reactivated, only relisted as a new one, so pause it with mercado_libre_set_listing_status unless the user wants it gone. Installed switched off; confirm with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_listing_description
tools.description: Read the description text of a listing (plain_text), with its creation and update dates.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

tools.name: mercado_libre_add_listing_description
tools.description: Add the description to a listing that has none yet, typically right after mercado_libre_create_listing. Plain text only (line breaks as \n, no HTML or emoji). If the listing already has a description Mercado Libre refuses it; use mercado_libre_update_listing_description. Confirm the text with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

plain_text.description: Description in plain text, in the site's language.

tools.name: mercado_libre_update_listing_description
tools.description: Replace the description of a listing. Plain text only (line breaks as \n, no HTML or emoji); an error names the position of a character that is not allowed. Possible whether or not the listing has sales. Confirm the text with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

plain_text.description: New description in plain text, in the site's language.
